tha-ap545:7.3: sarena mahatā vīro → sussarena mahāvīro (bj) | vīro idaṁ → dhīro imaṁ (sya-all) | vīro → sussarena mahāvīro (cck: sī. pī.)
tha-ap545:10.2: sattāhikampi → sattāhikaṁ hi (bj) | sattāhikampi vo → sattāhakādhikaṁ (sya-all) | vo → sattabhikādhikaṁ (bj: syā); sattāhikampi vo (bj: machasaṁ) | vo → sattahikaṁ mi vo (cck: sī.); sattahikādhikaṁ (cck: syā.); sattahikaṁ vibho (cck: pī.)
tha-ap545:11.4: suppatiṭṭhitā → patiṭṭhitā (bj: machasaṁ) | patiṭṭhitā → saṁghamhi suppatiṭṭhitā (cck: sī. pī.)
tha-ap545:12.1: dakkhiṇā tāya → dakkhiṇādāya (sya-all) | tāya → dakkhiṇādāya (cck: syā. pī.)
tha-ap545:16.4: tāvatiṁsūpago ahaṁ ekanavutito → tāvatiṁsaṁ agañchahaṁ ekanavute ito (sya-all)
tha-ap545:17.3: cārudassano → cārunayano (bj, sya-all) | cārunayano → cārudassano (bj: machasaṁ)
tha-ap545:18.3: passito → patthito (bj); vuṭṭhito (sya-all) | ceva → passito ceva (bj: machasaṁ)
tha-ap545:18.4: kammantavāvaṭo → kammantabyāvaṭo (sya-all) | kammantavyāvaṭo → vāvaṭo (bj: machasaṁ) | kammantavāvaṭo → kammantabyāvaṭo (cck: sī. syā. ka.)
tha-ap545:19.3: akārayi → akāresi (bj) | parivesaṁ akārayi mahantamativissutaṁ → pariveṇaṁ akāresi mahantamiti vissutaṁ (sya-all) | akāresi → akārayi (bj note)
tha-ap545:20.2: daduṁ khajjakasañhitaṁ → dadaṁ khajjakasaṁhitaṁ (bj) | khajjakasañhitaṁ → khajjakasaññutaṁ (sya-all) | dadaṁ → daduṁ (bj: machasaṁ) | khajjakasaṁhitaṁ → khajjakasañhitaṁ (bj: machasaṁ)
tha-ap545:26.3: duṭṭho dvārarodhamakārayiṁ → ruṭṭho dvārarodhaṁ akārayiṁ (bj) | ruṭṭho → duṭṭho (bj: machasaṁ)
tha-ap545:27.4: pāpatiṁ → pāpiṭṭhaṁ (sya-all) | papatiṁ → pāpatiṁ (bj: machasaṁ); pāpiṭṭhaṁ (bj: syā) | pāpatiṁ → pāpiṭṭhaṁ (cck: syā.); pāpattaṁ (cck: ka.)
